name: khoa-luan-docx-build

scripts.build: node build.js .. logo-neu.png ../khoa-luan-seclearn.tmp.docx && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File word.ps1 ../khoa-luan-seclearn.tmp.docx ../khoa-luan-seclearn.docx ../khoa-luan-seclearn.pdf && node -e "require('fs').unlinkSync('../khoa-luan-seclearn.tmp.docx')"
